mechanism.claim: When completed trailing realized variation and the canonical Ulcer Index are both unusually high, the market is moving inside a deep, persistent drawdown-stress state rather than an ordinary volatile fluctuation; follow the latest completed four-hour direction for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed four-hour close/open log return
mechanism.why_distinct: Ulcer Index is the root mean square of percentage drawdowns from a rolling closing high. It measures drawdown depth and persistence jointly, not duration alone, directional drawup/drawdown asymmetry, endpoint return, OHLC range, variance acceleration, path passage, volume, flow, OI, funding, a fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, and Ulcer Index must independently rank in its upper 30%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: four-hour rolling RMS drawdown-stress states are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.rolling_high: highest completed four-hour close over the current and prior thirteen valid consecutive bars
features.ulcer_index: sqrt(mean of the current and prior thirteen squared percentage_drawdown values), requiring the full nested warmup without gaps
features.ulcer_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.terminal_return: log(completed four-hour close/open), finite strict nonzero
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible: source valid, both frozen rank gates pass, and terminal return is strict nonzero

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after all feature inputs complete
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT perpetual open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Ulcer Index(14) RMS drawdown stress under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, drawdown definition, rank, variation gate, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Peter Martin canonical Ulcer Index convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: fourteen-period rolling closing high; percentage drawdown from that high; square; fourteen-period mean; square root
external_basis.selection_use: published fourteen-period RMS drawdown definition, terminal bar direction, and elevated-stress interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes
